{{Vanilla|Nether Fortress}}
A '''Nether fortress''' generates in [[Hell]] as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot: chests roll 4–8 times instead of 2–4, give more diamonds, iron and gold, and golden equipment comes from the pack's gold equipment table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/nether_bridge.json}}</ref>
